text: Fixing #6499: a cancel observed in an explicit FLOCK()/RLOCK() retry was folded into the ordinary .F. (pause_for_lock_retry returned false like a timeout), so 'RETURN FLOCK()' completed normally (CFTASKSTATUS=completed) even though runtime.task.cancelled fired. The cancelled explicit attempt now throws PrgPropagatedRuntimeError so the statement faults and the task ends with an error pause; cancel is also observed in the scheduler-yield path. Fail-first: the FLOCK test (previously pinning the bug) and a new RLOCK test both reported 'completed' before; full local ctest 400/400 after. Implicit locks and ordinary .F. contention unchanged.
